{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nudge for silent tool steps","id":"gh:1426698085","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-progress-rules","slug":"Adamaik/dsh-progress-rules","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dge for silent tool steps"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-progress-rules"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle plugin that
makes agents report progress instead of silently running"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" dozens of tool steps."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Two independent layers, both mounted by one bundle row:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **System-prompt section** — `user:progress-rules` at order `10150` (after the Web surface
section"},{"id":"p7s2","text":", before the deployment persona suffix). It carries your process-discipline rules and
is re-rendered"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" on every request, so conversation compaction can never summarize it away.
It uses its own section n"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ame, so a preset's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` row cannot shadow it
the way it shadows the deployment"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"s `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` row cannot shadow it
the way it shadows the deployment `personaSuffix`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"2. **Deterministic nudge** — on every `agent/pre-step`, the plugin checks whether the previous
assis"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tant message contained any text block. If it only carried tool calls (or reasoning),
that step count"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s as *silent*. After `everySteps` consecutive silent steps it injects one
user-role reminder into th"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"e next admitted step: "you ran tools without reporting, narrate in
1–3 sentences before continuing"."},{"id":"p8s5","text":" The reminder is a durable context message rendered as a
`progress-rules` context row, not as a mess"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"age from the user. Any narrated step resets the
counter."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The first layer is advisory for the model. The second layer is what actually breaks the
"40 silent s"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"teps" pattern, because the harness inserts the reminder itself instead of trusting
the model to reme"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n, because the harness inserts the reminder itself instead of trusting
the model to remember a rule."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DSH plugins are installed into a **profile** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`), not globally:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then add the bundle to the profile's `package.json` (order matters: bundles compose in list
order, s"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"o put it after the base bundles):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Restart DSH afterwards. If your DSH build ships the `dsh plugin` command, adding the dependency
and "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"the bundles entry is what that command does for you."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml` inside this package) declares one row:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Override it from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` by targeting the same row id. Patch semantics
repl"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ace the **whole** row config, so restate every key you keep:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `text` | bundled Chinese rules | System-prompt section text. Empty drops the section. |
| `name` |"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" `user:progress-rules` | Section name. |
| `order` | `10150` | Section order (WEB_SURFACE is 10100, "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"persona suffix 10200). |
| `enforce` | `true` | `false` disables the per-step nudge, leaving only th"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"e prompt section. |
| `reminder` | bundled one-liner | Text injected before a silent step. Empty dis"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ables the nudge. |
| `everySteps` | `5` | Consecutive silent steps before one reminder. `1` = every "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"step, larger = quieter. |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Why not AGENTS.md or `personaSuffix`?"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **`AGENTS.md`** is loaded as a durable user message in conversation history. On long tasks DSH
com"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"paction may summarize it away; the system prompt is never compacted.
- **`system-prompt.personaSuffi"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"x`** is shadowed for preset sessions: the shipped Standard / PTC /
Minimal presets mount `@deepseek-"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ai/dsh-persona`, which registers the same
`deployment:persona-suffix` section with empty text, hidin"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"g the deployment value. A differently
named section avoids that entirely."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, Standard preset, `deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017-cloud`.
- Plain ESM, no C"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ordis imports, no runtime dependencies; uses `node:crypto`.
- The nudge detects silence by checking "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"text blocks in the last assistant message. A provider
that reports assistant text in a custom block "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"type would not be recognized — open an issue."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
